card.name: Comma after coronary insufficiency; 'any' before indication
card.fires_on: The comma after 'especially coronary insufficiency' in the sympathomimetic amine caution sentence. Also the word 'any' in 'taking these drugs for any indication' in antiepileptic warnings.

modes.label: Comma in cardiovascular caution
modes.description: Comma right after 'coronary insufficiency' in the list of cardiovascular disorders for sympathomimetic amines.
modes.example: especially coronary insufficiency<<,>> cardiac arrhythmias, and hypertension.

modes.label: 'any' in AED warning
modes.description: The word 'any' just before 'indication' in the antiepileptic suicidal thoughts warning.
modes.example: increase the risk of suicidal thoughts or behavior in patients taking these drugs for<< any>> indication.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words like 'symptoms' and 'symptom' as the next word.
card.plain: It marks fixed warning phrases in drug labels where a list or a phrase is about to continue.
